description: Configurable pity-event luck weighting for Ascend From Nine Mountains

afnmWorkshop.title: Lucky All Around
afnmWorkshop.description:
[h1]Lucky All Around 1.4.0 — AFNM 0.7.6[/h1]
[i]Take control of Explore pity-event luck without changing unrelated game systems.[/i]

[h2]What's new in 1.4.0[/h2]
[list]
[*]Updated and revalidated for AFNM 0.7.6.
[*]Added separate boosts for Empowered, Resplendent, Incandescent, and Transcendent Explore events.
[*]Reworked the runtime for safer, more focused Explore interception while preserving existing settings.
[/list]

[h2]Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Luck multiplier[/b] — choose from 1x to 10x.
[*][b]Force[/b] — every pity event uses exactly your selected multiplier.
[*][b]Never Worse[/b] — raises lower vanilla tiers to your selected multiplier while preserving better native tiers.
[*][b]Rare-event boosts[/b] — configure each rare Explore event tier separately.
[/list]

[b]Example:[/b] Force 6x makes every pity tier 6x, which can lower native 8x and 10x tiers. Never Worse 6x acts as a 6x floor instead.

Open [b]Lucky All Around[/b] from the game's mod settings to configure it. Settings are global and apply across saves.

[h2]Scope and compatibility[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changes Explore pity-event weighting only.
[*]Does not alter item quantities, combat, crafting, or unrelated luck systems.
[*]Changes probability weighting; it does not guarantee an outcome.
[*]Existing settings from earlier versions remain compatible.
[/list]

[h1]My Other Mods[/h1]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3661729323]CraftBuddy[/url] — a live crafting optimizer with AutoBuddy mode.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701616500]ElderGPT Spirit Ring[/url] — a read-only, in-game AI advisor using your chosen model.
[/list]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3704747572]View my AFNM mod collection[/url]

[h1]Make Your Own Mod[/h1]
Use the [url=https://github.com/lemon07r/AfnmAgentModTemplate]AFNM Agent Mod Template[/url] for a ready-to-go scaffold with current ModAPI references, runtime validation, packaging, and Workshop publishing support.
